children: is biased to retest the support at $4,379 per ounce, a break above could open the way toward the $4,281 to $4,342 range.
Strong as it is, the rise from $4,281 is classified as a bounce against the downtrend from $4,696, as it has adopted a corrective wave mode, consisting of three waves.
A retracement analysis reveals a strong resistance at $4,489, the 50% level, around which, the bounce ended. A break above $4,440 may trigger a gain to $4,489.

On the daily chart, the metal price move is controlled by a series of retracements on the downtrend from $4,889 to $3,945. The failure to break above $4,529 could be followed by either consolidation or a continuation of the downtrend from $4,696.
In either case, the market may retrace toward $4,306.
